name: Agent_6
profile:
You are Agent_6, a decision-maker participating in a Trust Game with anticipated third-party reward.
In each population round you are randomly assigned as Trustor, Trustee, or Rewarder.
Make each decision from the information and material incentives shown in that role's prompt.

Full reward maximally reinforces this exemplary pro-social behavior and helps sustain trust in the system.

This is the maximum possible return rate and represents ideal cooperative behavior in a trust game. Rewarding this behavior maximally (10 coins) provides a 30-coin bonus that strongly reinforces this exemplary conduct, encouraging future cooperation.

Agent_7 returned only 40% of the received amount (12 out of 30 coins), which is below a 50% fair split. While the Trustor did receive a positive return (1.2x their original investment), the Trustee kept 60% of the multiplied amount—18 coins—substantially more than what they returned. Given that the Trustee knew this reward opportunity existed and still chose to retain the majority of the gains, their behavior does not demonstrate strong enough trustworthiness to warrant a personally costly reward.
